results.title: Expect to create 6,440 jobs via Rs 1,166 cr investment on 2 units in YEIDA: Spark Minda
results.description: Auto components maker Spark Minda will create approximately 6,440 jobs. This expansion involves two new manufacturing units in the YEIDA region. The company is investing Rs 1,166 crore in these new facilities. These plants will produce ignition switch-cum-steering locks and mechatronic components. A joint venture with Toyodenso will also establish a new plant in Noida.
